newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks dip at close as weighted scrips lose.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks dip at close as weighted scrips lose.

text.p: A sharp fall in a cement share and profit taking on some weighted scrips pulled Dhaka stocks down at the close in an active session on Monday, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all share price index fell 92.18 points or 4.75 percent at 1,846.29 on a turnover of 175.3 million taka. Of 125 traded issues, 69 lost, 51 rose and five unchanged.

Chittagong Cement lost nearly 45 percent after the authorities on Monday lifted a price fluctuation restriction on the share for three consecutive sessions. "That affected the overall price index most," said one broker. Chittagong Cement lost 4,749 taka to 5,997 and Shine Pukur Holdings shed 26.38 to 289.86.
